description: Veyra Canonical Ground Truth Reference Manifest for Meteorological Forecast Verification.

invariants.truth_sealing: All reference ground truth data is cryptographically sealed until verification timestamp (valid_time + latency_days).
invariants.no_backfilling_leakage: Reanalysis or post-processed reference data cannot be backfilled to simulate real-time availability.
invariants.provenance_traceability: Every evaluated prediction must record its reference source ID and verification timestamp.

references.name: ERA5 Atmospheric Reanalysis
references.access_protocol: Copernicus CDS API / WeatherBench2 Cloud Zarr
references.verification_role: Primary baseline for global thermodynamic & kinematic variables

references.name: IMD High-Resolution Gridded Daily Rainfall
references.provider: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Pune / National Climate Centre
references.verification_role: Authoritative ground truth for Indian rainfall verification

references.name: IMD Gridded Daily Maximum and Minimum Temperature
references.access_protocol: IMD Binary Archive / Python NetCDF Conversion
references.verification_role: Authoritative ground truth for heatwave & cold wave verification

references.name: IMD RSMC Official Best Track Cyclone Archive

coverage.spatial: North Indian Ocean (Bay of Bengal & Arabian Sea) [0-30N, 50-100E]

references.access_protocol: RSMC Annual Reports / CSV Best Track Archive
references.verification_role: Authoritative reference for tropical cyclone track and intensity
